claims.statement: If a finite 2-group has Frattini quotient C2^2 and all three nonzero classes contain center-free cyclic generators of order at least four, then each chosen cyclic subgroup D satisfies |D|^2 < |P|/2, hence |D|^2 <= |P|/4.
claims.scope: All finite 2-groups satisfying the stated hypotheses; no order cutoff.

claims.statement: A cyclic subgroup TPP triple in any finite 2-group satisfies |A||B||C| <= |P| if at least one factor has order at most four.
claims.scope: All finite 2-groups; proved by minimal-counterexample induction within the small-factor subclass.

claims.statement: An unrestricted cyclic-TPP counterexample of minimum ambient order has cyclic orders alpha >= beta >= gamma >= 8 and 8 alpha <= beta gamma.
claims.scope: Necessary conditions only; no exclusion for gamma >= 8.

claims.statement: Hou-Feng-Leemans Conjecture 3.3 holds whenever one distinguished pair product has order at most eight.
claims.scope: Uniform subfamily; a counterexample must have all three pair orders at least sixteen.

primary_sources.title: 2-Groups that factorise as products of cyclic groups, and regular embeddings of complete bipartite graphs
primary_sources.read_scope: Theorem 4.1 and proof (PDF pages 15-16), Lemma 2.1 including the multiplication and centrality statements (PDF pages 5-6), marked metacyclic restatement (PDF page 3). Not a claim of line-by-line review of the whole paper.
primary_sources.retained_input: Complete classification of marked isobicyclic 2-group pairs and the displayed coordinate multiplication rules.
primary_sources.redistribution: The source PDF and extracted full text are private reference material and are excluded from the original artifact package.

primary_sources.title: Regular embeddings of K_n,n where n is a power of 2. I: Metacyclic case
primary_sources.read_scope: Exact Theorem 1.1(1) marked normal form on the primary journal page; no local full-paper PDF or full-proof reading claimed.
primary_sources.retained_input: Marked pair a=g^u, b=g^u h with u odd and h^g=h^(1+2^f), 2<=f<=e.

computation.proof_boundary: Bounded exact diagnostics, not an all-parameter computation or an independent proof of the retained classification; full associativity checked only for n<=8, generator-local equations at larger n.

unresolved: The next minimum-factor boundary gamma=8, alpha=beta, |P|=4 alpha^2.
